newValues: Colours are read as 0xRRGGBB. The CFG does not state the channel order; this reading gives the green self, yellow friendly and red enemy the feature catalog describes.
Practice targets are drawn in the enemy colour. No other ships exist yet, so the friendly colour is loaded but nothing uses it.

How the eight newradar pieces join into a frame is RECONSTRUCTED (title plate, tiled title bar, end cap, side and bottom edges, the pipe corner at the lower right); the native layout code is not available.

The radar still shows the whole sector map, and the station, refinery, outpost and mineral marks keep their NEW colours. The original radar range, zoom, blip shapes, FontColor* keys and line-of-sight rules are not applied.
